title: launch_record
description: Payload of the single launch_record artifact written by fs_launch (/fs-launch, THE ONLY launch path): what was confirmed, what was launched and what came back.

launch_spec.description: path of the fs_launch_spec artifact that was confirmed and launched

plan_hash.description: plan_hash(spec_payload) recomputed exactly as confirm_before_launch computes it (first 16 hex of the canonical plan hash); it equals the hash the USER typed back — it is never auto-filled

confirmation.description: the composed confirm_before_launch confirmation_record's artifact id or path (the only confirmation this launch path accepts)

submitted.description: true when the request asked to submit to the scheduler (submit: true, default); false when the launcher ran here and waited (submit: false, local)

returncode.description: the launcher's return code (null for an sbatch submission); non-zero on a local run is FL-HO-001 / RED 5 — the run itself failed

result.description: interfaces.fs.launch.launch's returned dict, JSON-safe: {job_id, pid, command, dry_run_rc, returncode, log?, tail?, fs_verdict?, returncode_raw?}
